30350.creator: Army Specialist Fourth Class Dennis Kurpius

editorial.note: General notes: The following changes were applied to this restoration: global sharpness increased, filaments/dust removed, levels adjusted, cropped, local colours corrected.

Portrait of Sergei Mikhailovich Prokudin-Gorskii as part of his work to document the Russian Empire from 1904 to 1916. Prokudin-Gorsky's camera design required a camera operator to take three individual negatives after each other.
